I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team. The reply says the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Dock 23, and that nothing else is needed.

I didn't take any other action, as they asked. I also didn't save it to long-term memory. Their message in #central-team already records it, and a stored copy could later reach people who aren't in that channel.
